description.zh:
实例ID。

您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

> 如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID.

You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the invocation fails.

> If your public instance does not have an ID, see [How to Obtain an Instance ID](~~267533~~).
The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs.

title.en: Query the X.509 Certificate of a Device

descriptions.zh:
## 限制说明

- 仅支持地域为华东2（上海），且认证方式为X.509证书的设备。


- 单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。

    > RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Limits

- Only devices in the China (Shanghai) region that use X.509 certificates for authentication are supported.


- The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account is 10.

    > Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot query-device-cert --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-name light --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot QueryDeviceCert --region cn-hangzhou --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --ProductKey a1BwAGV0000 --DeviceName light
